in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'L-M-S' (ل مس), which means 'to make easy', 'to make light'. It can be translated as 'easy', 'gentle', or 'soothing'.

in_hindi.name: लामिसा

in_pashto.name: لاميسه
